entities.name: Ismail ibn Musa Menk

entities.summary: Ismail ibn Musa Menk, commonly known as Mufti Menk, is a Zimbabwean Islamic preacher, scholar and cleric who is the Grand Mufti of Zimbabwe, and head of the fatwa department for the Council of Islamic Scholars of Zimbabwe.
